cta_sub: Talk to us early, while you have the most options.

beats.say: I fell behind after I got hurt at work. Three payments.
Then this letter came today. Notice of default.
I don't even know what my options are anymore.
Mike, I'm Casa. First, take a breath. You're not the only one this happens to.
The earlier you act, the more options you usually have. Selling is one of them, and it's worth knowing what your house could bring in.
Who would buy it like this? The kitchen's falling apart.
We buy Florida houses as is, with cash. No repairs, no showings, and we can close in as few as twenty one days.
And I'm not obligated to anything?
Not at all. We'll show you the numbers, and you decide. It's also smart to talk with your lender or a housing counselor about every option.
Okay. Just knowing I have options helps.
That's the goal. A clear plan, on your terms.
If you're behind on payments on a Florida house, DM the word OFFER early, and we'll show you a no obligation cash offer.
